title: Adaptively Sparse Transformers
answer_short: The adaptively sparse Transformer improves interpretability by allowing attention heads to choose between focused or spread-out behavior through learnable sparsity patterns, uncovering different head specializations without sacrificing accuracy.
answer_rationale: The model introduces α-entmax, a differentiable generalization of softmax that allows low-scoring words to receive zero weight, enabling context-dependent sparsity. This sparsity, controlled by a learnable α parameter, allows attention heads to specialize in different ways (e.g., positional, BPE-merging, interrogation-detecting), making their roles more interpretable. The model achieves this without any loss in accuracy, as shown in experiments, and enables clearer identification of head specializations through sparsity, as demonstrated in the analysis section.
